title: Getting around Bangkok
note: Walking times are approximate, from the station exit to a shopping-centre entrance.
bts: City trains running above the street. The Sukhumvit and Silom lines meet at Siam.
mrt: Another city train network. Its Blue line connects with BTS at Asok / Sukhumvit. The BTS station is called Asok; the MRT station is called Sukhumvit.
mapNote: Selected stations only. Diagram not to scale.

centralworld.route: Covered raised walkway, above the main road.
centralworld.alternative: BTS Siam, Exit 4, is also connected by a longer raised-walkway route.
centralworld.prose: BTS Chit Lom, Exit 1: about 3–5 minutes on foot by a covered raised walkway. BTS Siam, Exit 4, is also connected by a longer raised-walkway route.

siam-center.train: BTS Siam · Sukhumvit and Silom lines
siam-center.route: Direct station link; no main-road crossing.
siam-center.prose: BTS Siam, Exit 2: about 1–2 minutes on foot by a direct station link. Both BTS lines stop here.

terminal-21-asok.train: BTS Asok · Sukhumvit line / MRT Sukhumvit · Blue line
terminal-21-asok.walk: BTS Exit 1: about 1–2 minutes. MRT Exit 3: about 2–3 minutes.
terminal-21-asok.route: Covered raised BTS link. MRT Exit 3 is on the shopping-centre side of the road.
terminal-21-asok.mapWalk: Asok, Exit 1: about 1–2 min. Sukhumvit, Exit 3: about 2–3 min.
terminal-21-asok.prose: BTS Asok, Exit 1: about 1–2 minutes via the covered raised link. MRT Sukhumvit, Exit 3: about 2–3 minutes on foot.

siam-paragon.train: BTS Siam · Sukhumvit and Silom lines
siam-paragon.route: Direct station link; no main-road crossing.
siam-paragon.prose: BTS Siam, Exit 3: about 1–2 minutes on foot by a direct station link. Both BTS lines stop here.

central-embassy.route: Covered station link; no main-road crossing.
central-embassy.prose: BTS Phloen Chit, Exit 5: about 2 minutes on foot by a covered station link. No main-road crossing is needed.

research.method: Station exits and connection types use the linked venue, rail-operator and tourism-authority sources. Minute ranges are approximate planning estimates from exits to entrances, not surveyed journey times; CentralWorld and Central Embassy estimates are informed by TAT descriptions. Map positions are schematic and do not encode distance.
